Download FinAccess survey files

Source: R/finaccess.R
knbs_download_finaccess.Rd

Downloads files listed by knbs_finaccess_files() from the FinAccess portal, under their official names, and proves they are the files the package catalogued. Before a transfer, a sixteen-byte request confirms the file's served name and size, so a file that has changed is refused before anything large moves. After it, the size is checked again and the SHA-256 must equal the catalogued one. A <file>.metadata.json sidecar beside each file records where it came from, the producers and their terms, so that knbs_read_microdata() and knbs_cite() can say so later.

Usage

knbs_download_finaccess(
  file,
  destination = ".",
  overwrite = FALSE,
  verify = TRUE,
  quiet = knbs_option("quiet")
)

Arguments

file

File ids from knbs_finaccess_files(), such as "hh2024-stata", or that function's result.

destination

Directory to write into; created if needed.

overwrite

Whether to replace a file already in destination.

verify

Whether to hold each file to the catalogue. FALSE downloads whatever the link serves now, under the name it is served with: for when the producers have revised a file since the catalogue was made. A web page is refused either way.

quiet

Whether to suppress messages and the progress bar.

Value

Invisibly, a tibble with one row per file: resource_id, file_id, original_name, local_path, download_url, downloaded_at, size_bytes, sha256, content_type, package_version and source_id. Pass it to knbs_read_microdata().

Details

Terms. The portal states no licence. FSD Kenya's terms for the 2013 survey on Harvard Dataverse restrict the data to statistical and scientific research, forbid redistributing it without FSD Kenya's written agreement, rule out investigating specific individuals or organisations, and ask publications to cite the source. Do not assume wider reuse is allowed: ask the producers first. The package never bundles these files. The first download in a session says so.

Already downloaded. A file already in destination is not downloaded again if it is byte-identical to the catalogued one; its record is returned instead. That makes knbs_read_microdata(knbs_download_finaccess("hh2024-stata")) safe to re-run. A file there that differs is left alone, and the call stops unless overwrite = TRUE.

Large files. The 2024 files are 160 to 290 MB. Downloads stream to disk and show progress unless quiet. They are not held to the package's request timeout; a transfer is abandoned only once it has stalled for that long. Google Drive serves a file too large for its virus scan after a notice saying it could not be scanned; the package requests the file directly, as the notice's own download button does, and relies on the checks above.

Registration. Asking for the 2013 survey's Stata copy, which Harvard Dataverse holds behind a registration form, raises knbs_error_authentication_required with the page to visit. knbsdata does not automate sign-in, licence acceptance or approval workflows.

See also

knbs_finaccess_files(), knbs_read_microdata()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# The 2024 household survey, Stata format (160 MB)
fa <- knbs_read_microdata(knbs_download_finaccess("hh2024-stata", "data"))

# Every round's documentation
knbs_finaccess_files(content = c("questionnaire", "manual")) |>
  knbs_download_finaccess("docs")
} # }
